fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-07-21 (afternoon, 13:45): The complainant reported that a certificate submitted in a loan application near Iniyan Puram College Road did not match the original. Contact details given by the complainant, Sanjay Raj, include the number 9000000083. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sanjay Gopal, using the number 9000000073. The complainant mentioned physical documents and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fake certificate reportedly arranged through an intermediary.
fields.Keywords: fake certificate, forgery, documents, college road, mobile number, digital document, afternoon, suspect
